title: Saudi Arabia Opposed Egypt's Inclusion in Mecca Defense Agreement
detail: Saudi Arabia reportedly opposed Egypt's inclusion in the Mecca defense agreement, according to sources familiar with negotiations. The revelation exposes internal divisions within the regional security pact centered on the Mecca framework, as Riyadh and Cairo hold differing views on the scope and membership of the arrangement. The disagreement highlights the complex dynamics shaping the Gulf's evolving security architecture amid broader regional realignments.

media.caption: Saudi Arabia opposed Egypt's inclusion in Mecca defense agreement, sources say
